description: A white, intricate chandelier suspended by a chain. The chandelier has a wide, circular top that tapers downwards into a more pointed, heart-like shape at the bottom. The body of the chandelier is composed of numerous vertical, rod-like elements arranged in a circular pattern, creating a cage-like effect. Inside this structure, a central support system branches out, holding what appear to be light bulb sockets or decorative elements resembling petals. The overall design suggests a delicate and somewhat ornate piece, possibly intended to cast interesting shadows when illuminated.
